const semantic = `python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json, re, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'tools')
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime

root = Path.cwd()
task = root / '.ai/task/repair-w55-20260929'
name = 'mod-tome.lua'
runtime = LuaRuntime(load_manifest())
loader = LocaleLoader(runtime)
before = loader.load_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + name]), logical_path=name)
after = loader.load_path(root / name, logical_path=name)
work = json.loads((task / 'WORKSET.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['items']
frozen = json.loads((task / 'BASELINE-records.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))[name]
expected_targets = {
    '0146e9d1630436f384afa08a4e2723aefa9a2bef68c0e4e78ffcc6e0d02cdb0d': '被烧焦',
    '35aeb59a10094706ef999ddcb167591f715f5182a270c223a147809b64ad1e76': '被心灵摧毁',
    '546a6e96d9a4963931cdace25ab51024f000a60dd3709b5b8f6ef58a75a4d598': '激活你的一部分内在魔力，用它来驱动你的能力。\\n\\t\\t在接下来 %d 回合中，所有主动技能的使用都不消耗资源。\\n\\t\\t你的资源仍须足以启动技能，失败率等仍照常生效。',
    '5c0fcda68e5b81f8851033370bb989914e6aedbc4bca63f0d836f57b55bcb225': '被‘美化’',
    '93aa427360bdea3fd48f6a9117f4ee5abbfbcf7aadafb981e1d6ee39e6744f82': '被时间扭曲',
    'beb0369eb88fb92ab1d659c3bf5c162d5f83242502010fe5fce7a223c9f11165': '被撕咬致残',
    'e923d2b8d0b9da723ca5a9accc6bdaec2314e3b10deeea0fd4d8dd258ff711fe': '目标使用技能时不消耗资源。',
}
def key(row):
    return (row.get('section'), row.get('source'), row.get('source_tag'))
allowed = {key(x): x for x in work}
assert len(work) == len(allowed) == len(expected_targets) == 7
assert len(before.records) == len(after.records)
before_map = {key(r): r for r in before.records if r.get('kind') == 'translation'}
for row in frozen:
    assert before_map[key(row)] == row
placeholder = re.compile(r'%[-+ #0]*\\d*(?:\\.\\d+)?[cdeEfgGiouXxqs%]')
def without_line(row):
    return {k: v for k, v in row.items() if k != 'line'}
def leading_tabs(value):
    return [len(line) - len(line.lstrip('\\t')) for line in value.split('\\n')]
changed = []
for old, new in zip(before.records, after.records):
    left, right = without_line(old), without_line(new)
    if left == right:
        continue
    record_key = key(old)
    assert record_key in allowed, ('out_of_scope_change', record_key)
    item = allowed[record_key]
    revision = item['entry_revision_identity']
    assert old.get('target') == item['target_preimage']
    assert {k: v for k, v in left.items() if k != 'target'} == {k: v for k, v in right.items() if k != 'target'}
    assert new.get('target') == expected_targets[revision]
    assert placeholder.findall(new['source']) == placeholder.findall(new['target'])
    assert new['target'].count('\\n') == old['target'].count('\\n')
    assert leading_tabs(new['target']) == leading_tabs(old['target'])
    assert all(line.rstrip(' \\t') == line for line in new['target'].split('\\n'))
    changed.append(revision)
assert len(changed) == 7
assert set(changed) == set(expected_targets)
info_revision = '546a6e96d9a4963931cdace25ab51024f000a60dd3709b5b8f6ef58a75a4d598'
info_item = next(x for x in work if x['entry_revision_identity'] == info_revision)
info = next(r for r in after.translations if key(r) == key(info_item))
assert info['target'].count('\\n') == 2
assert leading_tabs(info['target']) == [0, 2, 2]
assert placeholder.findall(info['target']) == ['%d']
print(json.dumps({
    'verified': True,
    'runtime': str(runtime.luajit),
    'records_before': len(before.records),
    'records_after': len(after.records),
    'translations_before': len(before.translations),
    'translations_after': len(after.translations),
    'changed_targets': len(changed),
    'non_target_changes': 0,
    'workset_exact_match': True,
    'exact_claim_targets': '7/7',
    'placeholder_invariants': '7/7',
    'preimage_line_structure_invariants': '7/7',
    'info_lf_count': 2,
    'info_leading_tabs_per_line': [0, 2, 2],
    'trailing_whitespace_in_targets': 0,
}, ensure_ascii=False))
PY`;
